test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Consider the below statements and identify the correct answer.

**Statement-I:** Plaster of Paris has a very remarkable property of setting into hard mass on wetting with water.

**Statement-II: **Plaster of Paris is used in chemistry laboratories for sealing air gaps in apparatus where air tight arrangement is required.

options.text: Statement-I is true, and Statement-II is false.
Statement-II is true, and Statement-I is false.

solution:
The correct answer __**Both the statements are true.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Plaster of Paris****'s characteristics:**

 
 
• When wetted with water or exposed to a mixture and left to dry, it solidifies into a **hard mass.**
 
• The substance is a fine **white powder.**
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• In order to assure proper healing, it is used in hospitals to **fix broken bones.**
 
• Due to its setting property, it is used to make** toys, decorative items, inexpensive ornaments, cosmetics, blackboard chalk, **and **statue casts.**
 
• It serves as a **fire-retardant substance.**
 
• It is used in **chemistry labs** to **close air gaps **in equipment when an airtight arrangement is necessary. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Calcium sulphate hemihydrate** is what makes plaster of Paris (calcium sulphate half-hydrate).
 
• **CaSO₄.12H₂O** is the plaster of Paris's chemical formula.
 
• **Gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O)** is heated to a temperature of **100 °C **to prepare it.
 
• Gypsum loses three-fourths of its water of **crystallization **when heated to a temperature of 100°C (373K), creating Plaster of Paris.
